6.17 rsCountRowsInPageSectionExpression
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
rsCountRowsInPageSectionExpression is a critical error that will occur (in Microsoft SQL Server 2005
Reporting Services) when the CountRows aggregate function is used in an expression within a
PageHeaderFooter.
